name: magpie-ark
description: magpie provider plugin for Volcengine Ark: Agent Plan team seats' 5-hour / weekly / monthly windows (GetSeatInfo → GetAgentPlanSeatAFPUsage), with GetAFPUsage as the fallback
author: hzk

summary.en: Volcengine Ark as a provider of its own: an Ark API key for chat and Responses on the Coding or Agent Plan, and the account's AccessKey ID and Secret for quota. Agent Plan Team windows come from the seat (GetSeatInfo → GetAgentPlanSeatAFPUsage), which GetAFPUsage can't serve (yetone/magpie#5338).
summary.zh: 把火山方舟接成独立 provider：Ark API key 走 Coding / Agent Plan 的 chat 与 Responses，账号 AccessKey ID / Secret 只用于读套餐额度。团队版 Agent Plan 的额度按席位读取（GetSeatInfo → GetAgentPlanSeatAFPUsage），不再撞 Ark 对 GetAFPUsage 的 403（上游 yetone/magpie#5338）。
